items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This interview is being conducted by Anthony Brown and Ken Kimery.

ctx.x: Today is July 8, 2012, and this is the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Interview with NEA Jazz Master, arranger-pianist-composer-cultural hero-cultural icon, and definitely an inspiration to all musicians everywhere, Eddie Palmieri, in the Omni Berkshire in New York City. Good afternoon, Mr. Palmieri.
Good afternoon, Anthony, and good afternoon, Ken.
This interview is being conducted by Anthony Brown and Ken Kimery. And we just want to begin by saying thank you, Mr. Palmieri...
